summary: acer aspire 5 gaming system state baseline
detected_fault: The laptop is unable to properly utilize the external GPU (EGPU) for display output due to thermal throttling, no display output on the built-in screen, and limited boot functionality.
suggested_solution: Force the laptop to use its own integrated graphics (iGPU) for display output or install a VGA cable to bypass the EGP and test if the issue is related to the GPU or connection.
